bundle.shortDescription: TNTL (TNT Launcher) — Minecraft launcher for Windows and Linux
bundle.longDescription: TNTL (TNT Launcher) is a Minecraft launcher for Windows and Linux with a Rust core, a headless CLI and a Tauri desktop shell. It installs vanilla, Fabric, Quilt, Legacy Fabric, Forge and NeoForge from official upstreams, and manages mods, modpacks, worlds, servers and accounts.
